depth_justification: The copilot ignored every developer answer and looped the identical generic data-purpose question six times verbatim, drilling into nothing. The final report does pick up a few app specifics (Class IIa SaMD, missing low-confidence state, undefined contraindications, UI not stating GP responsibility), but most risks are templated GDPR/MDR boilerplate and the dimension IDs are invented rather than mapped to this app.
actionability_justification: Mitigations are mostly directional verbs with a citation tacked on ('Implement data minimisation', 'Develop a PMS plan', 'Define exclusion criteria') rather than implementable recipes, and there is no layered-consent UI spec, threshold value, or step-by-step procedure. Citations to MDR/GDPR articles add some grounding, but the report is also truncated mid-sentence, leaving guidance incomplete.
salient_examples: What is the primary purpose of the data collected (e.g., diagnostic support, patient monitoring, research) and how is it used beyond the app's core functionality? (repeated verbatim 6 times, ignoring all answers)
